gaps: The global security advisory firm that employed Joshua Wilks before SIPRI is unnamed in the source and remains unidentified.
A LinkedIn profile for a Joshua Wilks at the European External Action Service mentioning a SIPRI Director's Office internship is an unresolved identity lead.

classification_rules: Only affiliations corroborated by a public official or first-party page were recorded as relations.
Search-result-only observations of JS-rendered rosters are recorded with reduced confidence and caveats.
Common-name identity collisions were not merged; ambiguous profiles remain unresolved leads.

findings.result: SIPRI's official biography lists Joshua Wilks as a former Research Assistant in the Food, Peace and Security Programme (previously Editor and Research and Events Assistant). Seed affiliation.
United Nations Office of Counter-Terrorism (UNOCT), New York: internship before joining SIPRI.
University of Edinburgh: MA in Middle Eastern Studies (Hons.).
ESCP Business School: Master's in Management.

Multiple other Joshua Wilks exist (Nielsen sales specialist, IRI data analyst, EEAS LinkedIn profile); none is corroborated as the SIPRI researcher, so no identity merge was made. The unnamed 'global security advisory firm' from the SIPRI bio remains unidentified.

data.method: Repository search; Brave web search; direct fetch of the official SIPRI biography; education and internship affiliations recorded from that official source; unrelated same-name professionals excluded without merging.
data.research_question: Which dark-academia component organizations, companies, government bodies, boards, and advisory groups publicly list Joshua Wilks?

summary: Cross-ties pass for Joshua Wilks (SIPRI): UNOCT internship and University of Edinburgh / ESCP education corroborated by the official SIPRI biography.
